name: Yuusha VS Inma ~Cheat Armor Nuidara Owari~
original_name: 勇者VS淫魔～チートアーマー脱いだら終わり～
source:
The protagonist is reincarnated into another world with the mission to defeat the Queen of Lust, embarking on a grand adventure!

With his cheat armor, he can blast away any enemy with just a touch!
Without the cheat armor, he's just an out-of-shape Earthling and will lose to any enemy!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ01536768.html/]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
主角重生到异世界，肩负击败色欲女王的使命，展开一场盛大的冒险！

凭借他的作弊盔甲，他只需轻轻一触就能炸飞任何敌人！
没有了作弊铠甲，他只是一个畸形的地球人，任何敌人都会输！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ01536768.html/]DLsite[/url]]
